QuestInfo.name: [Easy Magnus] Magnus Simulator
QuestInfo.0: There's supposedly a way to fight a simulation of #bMagnus#k. Talk to Edea.
QuestInfo.1: Speak with #bEdea#k at the #bHeliseum Reclamation HQ#k.
QuestInfo.2: You learned more about the #rMagnus Simulator#k from Edea.

0.0: Hey there! Forgive me if we've met, but I see lots of fighters come through here. The name's Piston.
0.1: I had the engineers build a training system to help get our warriors ready for facing down #rMagnus#k, the baddest boss of the Specters.
0.2: You can talk to #bEdea#k at the #bHeliseum Reclamation HQ#k if you want to know more.
0.3: Go talk to #bEdea#k if you're interested!

yes.0: The #bHeliseum Reclamation HQ#k is looking for capable fighters that might be able to face off with #rMagnus#k. Make sure you talk to #bEdea#k.

1.0: You came here for the #rMagnus#k Simulator?
1.1: You can take the portal to my right to enter the simulator. Do not come crying to me if you suffer a mortal stab wound.
1.2: Of course, a simulation cannot come close to Magnus's actual strength, but it should prepare our warriors for the challenge that faces him.

yes.0: Anyone who does well will receive a reward. You can collect coins from the Simulator to trade with #bShadowdealers#k.
yes.1: If you collect enough, you can even get the #bKaiserion#k, a custom Nova blade. It shares many of the traits of the legendary sword #bKaiserium#k, which Magnus now holds.
yes.2: #bKaiserion#k's blade is black. #bKaiserium#k's red hue came from Kaiser's solar connection. The replica does not have the same power, so it's simply not as strong.
yes.3: Just keep your cool in the simulator. It's not Magnus, but you can learn to fight him if you pay attention. Use the portal on the right when you're ready.

1.3: Anyone above level 115 with a good heart can try the Simulator. Why don't you give it a shot, if you're feeling lucky.
